title: Trace query plan (draft v0)
description: How an agent answers a natural-language question about an event trace with ephemeral cards. 1) Classify the question into an intent and scope. 2) Run the calls in order against an omp-stats-compatible API (`omp stats` serves it; Hermes sessions can be fed into the same dashboard). 3) Render the cards with the chosen layers, passing each card the JSON of the call it names. 4) Write a one-paragraph answer computed from the same data. The plan is the contract: a host can show it, replay it, or rerun it later against fresh data.

session.description: 'latest', 'last N', 'selected', or a session file from /api/sessions.

harness.description: Filter sessions by the agent harness that produced them.

range.description: Time range for dashboard endpoints ('today' → 24h, 'this week' → 7d, 'this month' → 30d).

calls.description: API calls in dependency order. Later calls may reference earlier results with {id[index].field}.

layers.description: Default layers for every card. The user can toggle them; cards re-render from the data they already have.

notes.description: Honest caveats the resolver added (e.g. fewer matching sessions than asked for, and what it used instead).

intent.description: explain_slowness: where wall time went (model / tools / idle), heaviest tool, longest span. tool_failures: tools ranked by failures over a range, then their failed spans. compare_sessions: two sessions side by side. subagent_cost: per-track cost in one session plus main-vs-subagent share over a range. errors: request failures by signature plus span failures. cost_breakdown: API-equivalent estimate by model, provider, billing component. frustration: user sentiment by model (counts only). walkthrough/session_overview: summary and timeline with transcript.

get.description: omp-stats path + query: /api/sessions, /api/session/trace?file=, /api/session/entry?file=&id=, /api/stats?range=, /api/stats/tools?range=, /api/stats/errors?range=&limit=, /api/stats/providers?range=, /api/stats/frustration?range=. {sessions[0].file} style references resolve from earlier calls; {sessions[*].file} fans out.

select.description: Client-side selection over a list result (the endpoint has no such filter).

where.description: Field filters: exact values, or '>0' style comparisons (harness, subagents, costTotal, …).

input.description: Call id whose JSON the card takes ('trace', 'tools', 'traces[0]'), or a list of ids for compare.

why.description: One line telling the user why this card answers the question.

layers.description: Overrides the plan's layers for this card.

fixture.description: Shape of data/trace-fixture.json on the public site: real omp-stats responses keyed by path, sanitized by tools/sanitize-trace.mjs.
